page_title: OSA 1-0 ALA | Osasuna v Alaves 04/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' The free kick is taken by Kike Garcia (Alaves), but ball is cleared.
90+1' Javi Lopez (Alaves) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
87' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
86' Pedro Rostoll has decided to substitute Luis Rioja and he is replaced by Ianis Hagi (Alaves).
84' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
84' A cross from Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
79' It is time for a substitution. Iker Munoz (Osasuna) is on for Aimar Oroz.
79' We are about to witness a substitution. Raul Garcia (Osasuna) is replacing Ante Budimir.
79' Jagoba Arrasate decides to make a substitution. Ruben Garcia will be replaced by Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna).
76' 1 - 0 Goal! Ruben Garcia slips it to Ante Budimir (Osasuna) on the edge of the box and he finds the top left corner with a great effort. The score is 1:0.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Samu Omorodion trots off the pitch and is replaced by Giuliano Simeone (Alaves).
74' Alaves work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
72' Osasuna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
72' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Corner kick. Osasuna will have an opportunity.

70' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the right post. Antonio Sivera guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
67' David Garcia is being substituted because of an injury. Jagoba Arrasate sends Unai Garcia (Osasuna) on the pitch.
67' David Garcia (Osasuna) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
66' David Garcia (Osasuna) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

65' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Sergio Herrera leaps like a salmon to deny him.
63' Osasuna fail to score from a corner as Antonio Sivera (Alaves) leaps to collect the ball.
62' Great teamplay by Osasuna as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
58' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
51' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
48' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
48' The attendance is 17215.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Alex Sola is replaced by Carlos Vicente (Alaves).
46' Half-time substitution. Jon Guridi (Alaves) is replaced by Kike Garcia.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' The corner is swung in but Alaves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+2' A long pass into the box is latched onto by Samu Omorodion (Alaves), who looks up and slams a terrific shot past the keeper but onto the right post. He did everything right but score!
45+2' Osasuna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+1' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.

45+1' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net. The ball is out of play. Osasuna will have a chance to score from a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
41' The Alaves players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
40' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Antonio Sivera makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner.
37' Osasuna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
35' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) plants a goal-bound header low towards the middle of the target after a nice cross inside the box, but one of the defenders manages to deflect it away.
32' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Alaves comes to nothing.

31' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Alaves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

29' David Garcia (Osasuna) rises above the defence to meet the corner. His timing is good, but he arrows his header just a few inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
28' Osasuna force a corner. They send men into the box.

28' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Osasuna.
24' That will be all from Abdel Abqar who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves).
24' It doesn’t look good for Abdel Abqar (Alaves); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
22' Looks like Abdel Abqar (Alaves) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
17' The free kick from Luis Rioja (Alaves) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out.
16' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lucas Torro (Osasuna) was quite harsh and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
15' Jagoba Arrasate is forced to make a change. Kike Barja is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Moi Gomez (Osasuna).
15' Kike Barja (Osasuna) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
14' Kike Barja (Osasuna) picks up an injury.
12' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.

12' Jon Guridi (Alaves) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Alaves.
10' Kike Barja (Osasuna) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
9' Kike Barja (Osasuna) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
6' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. It's a throw-in for Osasuna.
4' Alex Sola (Alaves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
2' A quickly taken corner by Alaves.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Alaves will have the kick-off.
Jorge Figueroa Vazquez was nominated as the referee for this game.
